description: Test A null calibration, luminous-companion alternative v2 (fit_policy_test_a_luminous_v2.json, second-order starts). Same H0 events as gv_sec6_h0_lum_v1 but 100 realizations per u0 node (the full H0 catalogue): u0 nodes 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, F146 = 21, g = 0, 500 events. Runner JSON/NPZ of the first 50 are linked from gv_sec6_h0_v1 / gv_sec6_h0_u6_v1; the other 50 per node are run with the dark v4 policy (only their PSPL fit and arrays are used). Then lrt_omega_profile.py with the luminous v2 policy and lrt_gross_vitells.py.
